description: Closed allowlist of active Event kinds whose explicitly named value slot intentionally accepts a schema selected outside event-payload.schema.json. An entry permits openness only inside value; the wrapper remains closed. Prose and implementations MUST identify and enforce the selected validation contract and MUST NOT describe the complete payload as closed.

exceptions.validation_contract: The moderation-policy document schema selected by value.schema; an absent or unregistered selector is rejected.
exceptions.rationale: Organization moderation policy documents are profile-selected and cannot be collapsed into one core shape.

exceptions.validation_contract: The registered disclosure-policy contract bound to policy_id; the reducer rejects an unknown policy family.
exceptions.rationale: Disclosure policies are credential-family specific while the stable policy cell is shared.

exceptions.validation_contract: The registered disclosure-receipt schema selected by value.receipt_kind; an absent or unknown kind is rejected.
exceptions.rationale: Receipts differ by disclosed credential family and proof system.

exceptions.validation_contract: value is a JSON Schema 2020-12 document whose canonical $id and registered Arkret schema id must match schema_id.
exceptions.rationale: A schema-definition event necessarily carries a recursive JSON Schema document.

exceptions.validation_contract: The registered policy-family schema bound to policy_id; generic policy objects use policy.schema.json and recovery policies use recovery-policy.schema.json.
exceptions.rationale: The shared policy cell carries multiple registered policy families.

exceptions.validation_contract: The registered action schema bound to the exactly-one policy_id or action_id subject; unknown subjects are rejected.
exceptions.rationale: Policy action logs are an envelope over registered action-family documents.
